objective: Measure whether one conservative value-only update of the alpha-0.50 HalfKP initializer on a deterministic color-balanced subset of the existing pure depth-12 teacher corpus improves direct play against the immutable live baseline.

hypothesis_boundary.single_question: Does a fixed one-epoch, one-arm value-only update pass a fresh 56-game direct-play screen?
not_claimed: Static validation loss or teacher agreement is playing strength.
More rows, more epochs, or more hyperparameter arms are guaranteed to help.
A passing 56-game screen is sufficient for live promotion.

deterministic_dataset.selection_rule: Validate the complete pinned source, reject duplicate position_id values, parse the SFEN side-to-move field, compute the selection digest, and retain the smallest required number of digests independently for b and w.
deterministic_dataset.output_order: selection digest ascending, then position_id ascending across both selected sides
required_checks: All source byte counts and SHA-256 values match this plan before sampling.
Every output row is byte-identical to one pinned source row and uses its cp target only.
No WDL, game outcome, policy, rank, or sibling target is introduced.
Training and validation have the exact preregistered row and side counts.
Every position_id is unique within each pinned source.
There is no game, position_id, or normalized semantic-position overlap across splits.
The sampler writes a manifest with source and output hashes only after all checks pass.

fixed_arm.optimizer: AdamW using the trainer default weight decay

forbidden_adaptation: No second seed, learning rate, epoch count, sample size, or training arm.
Do not select or rerun from validation loss, teacher agreement, or match trajectory.
Do not add WDL, policy, rank, sibling, or outcome supervision.

required_before_match: All pinned input and derived-dataset fingerprints match.
All model parameters and recorded metrics are finite.
The epoch-one checkpoint exports successfully to the int16 research format.
PyTorch, TorchScript, and research WASM scores are bit-exact on at least 200 frozen positions.
The live weight file and production deployment artifacts remain byte-identical to their preregistered fingerprints.

quantization.interpretation: Both candidate quantization-error measures must be no worse than 1.05 times the corresponding initializer measure.

direct_play_gate.candidate: the sole epoch-one candidate after the correctness gate
direct_play_gate.transposition_table: clear before every game and retain only within that game

downstream_if_pass.next_gate: a separately preregistered independent 96-game fresh-opening confirmation

stop_rules: Stop before export or direct play if any correctness gate fails.
Stop this B12 family if the 56-game score is below 62 candidate halfpoints; do not automatically expand to 800k rows, depth 16, more epochs, seeds, or variants.
A pass authorizes only a separately preregistered independent 96-game confirmation.
Depth 16 may be reconsidered only after a separately preregistered depth-12-versus-depth-16 diagnostic shows a teacher-depth difference not drowned by student error.
Never write the live weight path from dataset preparation, training, export, or match code.
claim_boundary: This file preregisters one prospective experiment. It contains no training result, direct-play result, playing-strength claim, or live-change authorization.
